name: Hotel Kannappa
signature_dish: Chettinad-style biryani — one of around ten biryani varieties
why_it_matters: A Trichy institution at Mannarpuram, ranked among the city's top restaurants on TripAdvisor with over 8,000 reviews — Hotel Kannappa is the address for Chettinad biryani, offering around ten biryani varieties plus a full Chettinad non-veg spread. Famously busy at lunch, with strangers sharing tables, it is the city's defining biryani-and-Chettinad experience.
insider_tip: Go for lunch (roughly 12.30-4.30pm) when the biryani is freshest and expect to share a table — that crowd is the point. Mutton biryani and the Kannappa special grilled chicken are the orders. Cash + cards.
signature_address: 22-25 Mannarpuram 4 Road, KK Nagar, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620020

name: Woodlands Restaurant (Femina Hotel)
signature_dish: Classic South Indian vegetarian meals in an old-school dining room
why_it_matters: The restaurant inside Femina Hotel on Williams Road, a Trichy Cantonment hospitality landmark since 1987 — Woodlands offers a classic, unadulterated vegetarian dining experience with South and North Indian food in a comfortable air-conditioned room. A dependable Cantonment-area meal for travellers.
insider_tip: Reliable, comfortable vegetarian dining in the Cantonment near the railway station — good for a meal when you want consistency over adventure. The South Indian meals are the safe order. Cash + cards.
signature_address: Femina Hotel, 109 Williams Road, Cantonment, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620001

name: Shri Sangeethas Veg Restaurant
signature_dish: Hot, fresh South Indian vegetarian meals with a generous spread
why_it_matters: A well-rated pure-vegetarian restaurant in Thillai Nagar, one of Trichy's main dining neighbourhoods — Shri Sangeethas is praised for South Indian meals served hot and fresh with a generous spread and prompt service. A consistent family choice for a clean vegetarian meal.
insider_tip: Order the South Indian meals for a generous, balanced plate. Thillai Nagar is a good area to base a Trichy food evening. Cash + cards + UPI.

name: Hotel Saravana Bhavan
signature_dish: South Indian tiffin and meals — dosa, idli, mini tiffin
why_it_matters: A Saravana Bhavan outlet in the Trichy Cantonment serving the chain's standard reliable South and North Indian vegetarian tiffin and meals — a clean, consistent option near the railway and bus area, the default safe meal for travellers arriving in or passing through Trichy.
insider_tip: Convenient Cantonment location for a clean tiffin breakfast near the station. The mini tiffin is the efficient order. Cash + cards + UPI.
signature_address: Salai Road, Cantonment, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620001

name: Vasanta Bhavan
signature_dish: South Indian tiffin and meals near the Rockfort
why_it_matters: A pure-vegetarian South Indian restaurant on West Boulevard Road near the Rockfort Temple — Vasanta Bhavan is a handy everyday tiffin-and-meals stop in the old-city core, useful for a quick clean meal while exploring the Rockfort and the bazaar streets around it.
insider_tip: Best paired with a Rockfort climb — eat a tiffin breakfast here before the steps, or a meal after. Basic, central, dependable. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: West Boulevard Road, near Rockfort, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu 620002

name: New Maduraa Hotel
signature_dish: South Indian non-vegetarian meals — biryani and Chettinad dishes
why_it_matters: A well-rated everyday non-vegetarian restaurant in Trichy serving South Indian and Chettinad food — New Maduraa Hotel is a dependable, value-priced address for biryani, Chettinad chicken and parotta, a step down in price from Hotel Kannappa while still delivering hearty Tamil non-veg.
insider_tip: A solid budget alternative for biryani and Chettinad non-veg if Hotel Kannappa is too crowded. Biryani and parotta with chukka is the move. Cash + UPI.
